messages.subject: Global Executive Profile | Energy, Industrials, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Ethovia Global Team,

Your global boutique model across executive search, industrials, energy and leadership advisory aligns closely with my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where responsible growth, institutional engagement and complex cross-border execution are central to performance. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
